As a result, you set one price, but guests see a higher price that includes their service fee. Many hosts tell us this makes pricing difficult. To simplify pricing, we’re combining both fees into a single 15.5% service fee on September 15. The 15.5% fee is based on Airbnb’s global average service fees. We built a tool that helps you adjust prices to account for the single service fee.* This video guides you through the change. Watch video [https://www.airbnb.ae/resources/hosting-homes/a/simplifying-service-fees-on-airbnb-771?src_section=12778729545643&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18] Adjust prices by the September 15 deadline to keep your payouts the same. If you don’t, your payouts will be lower. Get started [https://www.airbnb.ae/hosting/host-service-fee-update?src_section=12555402529064&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18] https://www.airbnb.ae/external_link?src_section=12704116624752&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18&url=https://www.instagram.com/airbnb https://www.airbnb.ae/external_link?src_section=12704116624752&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18&url=https://www.tiktok.com/@airbnb https://www.airbnb.ae/external_link?src_section=12704116624752&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18&url=https://www.youtube.com/@airbnb https://www.airbnb.ae/external_link?src_section=12704116624752&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18&url=https://twitter.com/Airbnb Airbnb Ireland UC 8 Hanover Quay Dublin 2, Ireland *In most cases, taxes like VAT/GST are assessed on the service fee. Your price adjustment includes these taxes unless you’re VAT/GST registered and required to account for them yourself. Learn more about VAT and how it applies to you [https://www.airbnb.ae/help/article/436?src_section=12704116624752&c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMjI3MzI0NjYzMzE2&euid=64763fde-8dd1-8126-2706-49547a454c18], including current rates by country.
